DAVIS All three tools use each bag's IMU weights from the residuals in UZH's own Kalibr results. Kalibr's intrinsics and baseline are inputs from the calibration UZH ships. Every tool starts from the camera chain UZH ships and uses the same IMU sigmas on the same bags. Kalibr keeps the camera values fixed; MVIS and Basalt refine them.

Run config · MVIS · mvis cam-imu
mvis cam-imu -c configs/cam_imu_<bag>_kalibr_model.yaml

davis_indoor_45, commit f5cdce0

input: davis_indoor_45.bag
<b>tags</b>

Runs (2, gyro and accel noise density; bias sigmas are 0.1 of these):

  • davis_indoor_45 · gyro 1.50e-03 · accel 2.50e-02
  • davis_indoor_forward · gyro 3.00e-03 · accel 2.50e-02
Run config · Kalibr · kalibr_calibrate_imu_camera
kalibr_calibrate_imu_camera --bag input.bag --cams camchain.yaml --imu imu.yaml \
    --imu-models scale-misalignment --target target.yaml --timeoffset-padding 0.1 --dont-show-report

imu.yaml for davis_indoor_45

accelerometer_noise_density: 0.025

Runs (2, gyro and accel noise density; bias sigmas are 0.1 of these):

  • davis_indoor_45 · gyro 1.50e-03 · accel 2.50e-02
  • davis_indoor_forward · gyro 3.00e-03 · accel 2.50e-02
Run config · Basalt · basalt_calibrate_imu
basalt_calibrate_imu \
    --dataset-path \
    x.bag
